text: Marquez Brothers International, Inc. owns the El Mexicano Brand; its CEO Gustavo Marquez Jr. said so in LAFC's announcement of the back-of-kit partnership.
short: Marquez Brothers International, Inc. owns the El Mexicano Brand.

source.name: LAFC – LAFC Announces El Mexicano Brand as Club's First-Ever Back-of-Kit Partner
source.quote: said Gustavo Marquez Jr., CEO of Marquez Brothers International, Inc., owner of El Mexicano® Brand
